calibration_step.instruction: Calibration - EMG Right Leg. Click "Next" to continue
Flex-point your right foot 3 times, pausing for 5 second between each time.
Calibration - EMG Left Leg. Click "Next" to continue
Flex-point your left foot 3 times, pausing for 5 second between each time.
Sit in upright position for 10 seconds
